title: OMT protocol events (v1)
description: Durable per-home event stream (F4, R11). EventEnvelope carries a per-home monotonically increasing cursor; consumers resume via events/resume. Attention payloads carry the required action, qualified reference, reason, optional deadline and recovery options — never lease secrets. The type field mirrors payload.kind for cheap client switching; producers keep them equal.

RunChangedEvent.description: Run-level state changed (created, started, paused, resumed, canceled, completed...).

RunItemChangedEvent.description: One run member changed state (claimed, reported, retried, removed...).

AttentionRaisedEvent.description: Human or agent attention required: carries required action, qualified reference, reason, optional deadline and recovery options without lease secrets (R11). DSH maps this to followup/inject delivery.

recoveryOptions.description: Open-vocabulary recovery tokens, e.g. "run/control retry", "human confirm".

SnapshotResyncEvent.description: Retention expired before a consumer's cursor: resynchronize from snapshot. prunedThroughSeq/consumerCursor are additive U5 fields retained optional until retention pruning ships.

prunedThroughSeq.description: Additive keying aid (U5): every event with cursor <= prunedThroughSeq was pruned by retention; consumers resuming from an older cursor must resynchronize instead of replaying.

consumerCursor.description: Additive keying aid (U5): the consumer cursor that triggered this resync, so a consumer can correlate the signal with its own resume attempt.

NodeQuarantinedEvent.description: Reindex quarantined a DB node whose Markdown file is gone (R19): identity snapshot preserved in the quarantine table; nothing silently deleted or rebound. Consumers must refresh any cached tree.

path.description: Last known home-relative Markdown path of the missing member.

EventPayload.description: Any committed event payload, discriminated by its kind constant.

EventType.description: Mirror of payload.kind carried on the envelope for cheap switching.

EventEnvelope.description: One durably committed event of one home.

EventBatch.description: Ordered page of the event stream as returned by events/resume.
